name: match-review
description: Review a match or competition for a team coach: what the plan was, what happened in each phase of the game, three things that worked and three to improve, evidence from notes or stats, individual development notes kept private, and what changes in training this week. Use when asked to review Saturday's match, write a match report for the players, what should we take from this loss, analyse these match stats, or prepare my team talk for Monday. Produces a coach's review, a short player-facing version, private individual notes, and the training implications. Distinct from retro-analysis, which reviews a sprint.
